definitions.name: Z1D.CSTEP

definitions.name: Z1D.BDELTA
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'Z1D.K' BIND 1 -1 '()[]' Z1D.K SEARCH 2 Z1D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 for an opener, -1 for a closer

definitions.name: Z1D.NILMASK

definitions.name: Z1D.LINE
definitions.body: 'Z1D.O' BIND Z1D.O 'price' GET 0 Z1D.O 'price' HAS? SELECT Z1D.O 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: Z1D.QBS
definitions.body: 'Z1D.OS' BIND Z1D.OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP Z1D.OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'Z1D.G' BIND Z1D.G KEYS Z1D.G VALUES [ Z1D.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record sku -> total qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: Z1D.CAP

definitions.note: word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case
